objective: Accurate known-force forward responses, defensible physical uncertainty, then evidence-based active probing
pilot_validation: Four previously collected old validation layouts; only candidate controls for development, no evaluation control fitting
heldout_policy: 32 new independent layout seeds, two replicates of each support/load combination; no predictive labels opened before freezing selected models and likelihood; sensor QC may inspect captures only for infrastructure checks

forward_gate.qualification: Development acceptance thresholds, not claimed achieved; report each support type, force direction, phase and amplitude; no TEST selection

uncertainty_gate: Matching declared prior and likelihood, numerical reference with progressively marginalized nuisance parameters; noise/discrepancy calibrated on reserved TRAIN controls only; nominal90% coverage assessed with uncertainty and proper predictive scores, not interval width alone
active_gate: One of four calibrated pokes, same observations/budget for all policies, independent diagonal target; compare predictive risk to random expectation and fixed0/fixed_last with paired layout confidence intervals; superiority only if interval excludes no gain

simulation.failure_policy: Preserve failed/partial fixed recipes; never replace based on outcome

resource_policy: GPU0 initial fits; GPU1/2 single-case Isaac queues; CPU audit/features/statistics. GPU3 left available for existing display workload. Reassign only after observing current utilization.
publication_policy: Push source, protocols, progress and reproducible result summaries; archive large raw data/models with checksums; preserve previous sealed study and all negative trials
